description: Platform State Boundary矩阵 - 验证三平台State归属权的一致性（State由Kernel持有，非Adapter持有）

matrix.android: Kernel owns state; Android Provider is stateless
matrix.ios: Kernel owns state; iOS Provider is stateless
matrix.desktop: Kernel owns state; Desktop Provider is stateless

matrix.android: Android Provider holds no Kernel state
matrix.ios: iOS Provider holds no Kernel state
matrix.desktop: Desktop Provider holds no Kernel state

matrix.android: Adapter→Bridge→Provider does not override Kernel state
matrix.ios: Adapter→Bridge→Provider does not override Kernel state
matrix.desktop: Adapter→Bridge→Provider does not override Kernel state

matrix.android: Bridge DTO state maps to Kernel state contract only
matrix.ios: Bridge DTO state maps to Kernel state contract only
matrix.desktop: Bridge DTO state maps to Kernel state contract only

statement: State归属在所有三个平台完全一致：State由Kernel统一持有（InvocationFSM、SessionManager），Adapter和Provider均为无状态组件。Bridge DTO状态仅映射到Kernel State合同。
